history.changes_cs: Jarvis dogfood pro WDUi Skin Editor doplnil SkinLibraryIdPropertyCoverage: skin-library id je bezpecna schema-backed textova vlastnost s validaci a Jarvis po dokonceni rezu korektne zastavi jako planning pass.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma novy recovery self-test pro prerusene worker journaly a release build overuje, ze obnova rozdelane prace nebere ukoncene nebo spatne pojmenovane zaznamy.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds a recovery self-test for interrupted worker journals, and the release build verifies that work recovery ignores completed or malformed job records.

history.changes_cs: Pridava okno Obnova prace v menu Nastroje: prerusene ulohy jdou zkontrolovat, znovu zaradit, oznacit jako opustene nebo exportovat bez spamovani chatu.
history.changes_en: Adds a Work recovery window under Tools: interrupted jobs can be reviewed, safely requeued, marked abandoned, or exported without spamming the chat.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pridava dialog Sdilene pracovni povedomi: v Nastroje lze zobrazit relevantni zdrojove chaty ze stejneho projektu, precist si duvod relevance a otevrit zdrojovy chat bez spamovani konverzace.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds a Shared work awareness dialog: Tools can show relevant source chats from the same project, explain why they matter, and open the source chat without spamming the conversation.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu publikovan na vyzadani s aktualnim CPM/WDUi stavem a cerstvym setup/update manifestem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was republished on request with the current CPM/WDUi state and a fresh setup/update manifest.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl publikovan na vyzadani s aktualnim CPM/WDUi stavem, setupem a ADPU update manifestem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was published on request with the current CPM/WDUi state, setup package, and ADPU update manifest.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis lepe predava SharedWork zdroje modelu: prompt obsahuje duvody shody a pravidlo, ze jde jen o read-only kontext z jinych chatu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now passes SharedWork sources to the model with relevance reasons and an explicit read-only other-chat rule.

history.changes_cs: Diagnostika Jarvise ukazuje SharedWork zdroje, ze kterych worker pri odpovedi cerpal.
history.changes_en: Jarvis diagnostics now show SharedWork sources used by the worker while answering.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl publikovan na vyzadani s aktualnim stavem CPM a WDUi artefaktu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was published on request with the current CPM and WDUi artifact state.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl publikovan s aktualnim buildem, setupem, checksumem a pripravou sdileneho pracovního povedomi mezi chaty.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was published with the current build, setup, checksum, and shared work awareness preparation between chats.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis uklada worker checkpointy do Sdileneho pracovniho povedomi a dalsim chatum ve stejnem projektu pridava kratky read-only kontext z jinych chatu bez prava je ukolovat.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now publishes worker checkpoints into Shared Work Awareness and adds concise same-project read-only context from other chats without allowing chats to assign work to each other.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl publikovan s aktualni WDUi build-info integraci a roadmapou Sdileneho pracovniho povedomi bez regrese verejne verze. Build cesta Jarvise kompiluje WDUi vcetne DesignUiBuildInfo.cpp a release setup navazuje na predchozi 0.1.479 opravy.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was published with the current WDUi build-info integration and Shared Work Awareness roadmap without regressing the public version. The Jarvis build path compiles WDUi including DesignUiBuildInfo.cpp and the release setup builds on the previous 0.1.479 fixes.

history.changes_cs: Diagnostika Jarvise nově exportuje souhrn agentické stopy: poslední úkol, routing, použitý model, policy/executor průběh a poslední problém bez zahlcení běžného chatu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis diagnostics now export an agent trace summary: latest job, routing, selected model, policy/executor flow, and last problem without cluttering normal chat.
